maturity.basis: Engineering estimate, not a measured benchmark.
maturity.changeReason: No increase for controlled regression alone; real Agent execution, feedback-driven cut changes and transfer remain unqualified.

capabilities: Existing construction loop now gates exact selected semantic scopes in Rust instead of aggregate-count-only comparison.
Strict cuts retain their receipt-content policy and portable operation evidence across semantic staging.
Strict semantic writer preflight rejects absent inherited coverage or drift before creating a network client.

regressions.semantic_round_gate_rejects_borrowed_gai: Selected failure cannot borrow sibling gain; parent, round, source catalog, policy, totals and unchanged replay are checked.
regressions.semantic_closure_preserves_preverified_o: Unchanged prior verified operation evidence composes with semantic closure; tampering rejects.
regressions.mixed_semantic_and_operation_rounds_pres: Operation -> semantic -> operation passes through Rust and the existing Python TableGit staging adapter; final reassessment equals the original report after all prior directories are removed.

limitations: Controlled fixture facts and recorded receipts, not newly executed construction Agents or target builds.
The semantic gate compares independently produced assessments; exact Blob validation and bounded Agent capture remain separate prerequisites.
Legacy input policies remain explicitly labeled legacy; this change does not automatically migrate published knowledge.
No new live TableGit transaction, release activation, calibrated case execution or emulator qualification.
Full gap-plan dispatch, productive real feedback rounds and structurally different repository transfer remain required.
